entries.zh: 相好；结为情人（男女私相恋爱）
entries.en: to become lovers; to take a paramour

entries.zh: 与伊相好；同他/她要好
entries.en: to be on good (amorous) terms with him/her

entries.zh: 割不断；情好缠绵、分不开
entries.en: inseparable (lovers who cannot be parted)

entries.zh: 相欠债；多世情缘、彼此亏欠（谓久相好）
entries.en: mutual debt (of former lives); long-standing attachment

entries.zh: 契家；相好成家、姘居（如无赖靠此谋利）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: contracted (irregular) union; keeping a paramour, as the ruffian profits thereby
entries.notes: L 栏句尾有缺损（-），契家兼指姘居关系，据 abarraganad 推断。

entries.zh: 熟骨；交情极深、故意相好而不分离
entries.en: bosom friends; deliberately inseparable intimates

entries.zh: 熟查某；相好的妇人、姘头
entries.en: familiar woman; kept mistress, concubine

entries.zh: 嫽娋；私通、狎昵苟且之事〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: illicit cohabitation, wantonness; whoring
entries.notes: 一字音记 T99 污损；嫽娋为罕见字，义据西语 amancebamiento/puteria 推断。

entries.zh: 黎明；天将明
entries.en: at daybreak; dawn

entries.zh: 惜；疼惜、爱惜〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to cherish, to love dearly (marginal note)
entries.notes: A Mar. 为边注，第二音 gelan 未明（或为囝），仅据汉字惜定义。

entries.zh: 惜福；爱惜福分
entries.en: to cherish one's blessings (lit. love one's good fortune)

entries.zh: 惜死；爱惜性命、怕死
entries.en: to cling to life; to be afraid of dying

entries.zh: 惜性命；爱惜性命
entries.en: to cherish one's life

entries.zh: 相惜；彼此爱惜（惺惺相惜）
entries.en: to cherish each other; mutual regard

entries.zh: 爱；爱慕、喜爱
entries.en: to love, to desire

entries.zh: 爱慕；深情地爱（暮或为慕之讹）
entries.en: to love with affection; to adore
entries.notes: 封存件标注 [疑:暮/慕]，第二字有异文。

entries.zh: 好（hào）；喜爱、爱好
entries.en: to be fond of, to like

entries.zh: 好色；贪色、淫好
entries.en: to be lustful, given to lewdness

entries.zh: 宠；宠爱（爱其卑下者，或因其德、或受其欺瞒）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to favor, to dote on an inferior (for his virtues or through deceit)
entries.notes: 汉字栏作「罷」但官话对音 chòng 指向「宠」，字形存疑，据对音与西语释义定夺。

entries.zh: 宠爱；因贤德而宠爱其人
entries.en: to favor for one's virtues
entries.notes: 首字音记 T99 污损；同上条以「宠」解。

entries.zh: 宠倖；宠爱亲近之人（纵使其品行恶劣）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to dote upon a favorite even if wicked
entries.notes: 首字音记 T99 污损，末音展开存疑；据 L 栏释义与官话对音定为「宠倖」。

entries.zh: 宠赐；君王恩宠赏赐
entries.en: royal favor and reward
entries.notes: 首字音记 T99 污损；据 L 栏 Amar y premiar el Rey 与官话对音定为「宠赐」。
